b2-puertorico-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What Surprises Visitors
b2-puertorico-01.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are watching a documentary about El Yunque in Puerto Rico, and she asks what visitors notice most.
b2-puertorico-01.prompt: Tell Meg what surprises visitors most, putting that idea in the spotlight.
cues: Say that the amount of rain is what surprises them
b2-puertorico-01.target: Lo que más sorprende a los visitantes es la cantidad de lluvia.
b2-puertorico-01.english: What surprises visitors most is the amount of rain.
b2-puertorico-01.canDo: I can put one idea in the spotlight with a cleft sentence (*Lo que… es…*, *Fue… cuando…*).

b2-puertorico-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Autonomy Before the War
b2-puertorico-02.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are reading an article about 1898 in Puerto Rico, and he asks whether Spain had already granted autonomy.
b2-puertorico-02.prompt: Tell Carlos when Spain granted autonomy, in relation to the war.
cues: Say that it was before the war began
b2-puertorico-02.target: España concedió la autonomía antes de que empezara la guerra con Estados Unidos.
b2-puertorico-02.english: Spain granted autonomy before the war with the United States began.
b2-puertorico-02.canDo: I can say that one event happened before or after another with *antes de que* and *después de que*.

b2-puertorico-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Statehood Would Mean
b2-puertorico-03.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are reading about the options for Puerto Rico's political status, and she asks what one of them would mean.
b2-puertorico-03.prompt: Describe what one option would mean, without taking sides.
cues: Say what would change for the citizens
b2-puertorico-03.target: Si Puerto Rico fuera un estado, sus ciudadanos elegirían senadores con voto.
b2-puertorico-03.english: If Puerto Rico were a state, its citizens would elect senators with a vote.
b2-puertorico-03.canDo: I can describe what an imagined situation would mean with *si* + imperfect subjunctive and the conditional.

b2-puertorico-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Salsa and the Island
b2-puertorico-04.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are listening to a talk about Puerto Rican music, and he asks whether salsa is from the island.
b2-puertorico-04.prompt: Tell Carlos that salsa did not begin on the island but Puerto Ricans were important in it.
cues: Grant the point that it did not begin there
b2-puertorico-04.target: Si bien la salsa no nació en la isla, muchos puertorriqueños fueron figuras importantes.
b2-puertorico-04.english: Although salsa was not born on the island, many Puerto Ricans were important figures in it.
b2-puertorico-04.canDo: I can grant a true point and then give the main idea with *si bien*.

b2-puertorico-05.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Hurricane
b2-puertorico-05.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are reading an article about Hurricane María, and she asks what the communities did afterwards.
b2-puertorico-05.prompt: Tell Meg what many communities did and for what purpose.
cues: Say what they did it for
b2-puertorico-05.target: Muchas comunidades se organizaron con el fin de repartir agua y comida.
b2-puertorico-05.english: Many communities organised in order to hand out water and food.
b2-puertorico-05.canDo: I can say what an action is for with *con el fin de*, *con miras a* and *de modo que*.

b2-puertorico-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: When Was It Protected
b2-puertorico-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. After the unit on Puerto Rico, Carlos asks what you remember about El Yunque.
b2-puertorico-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos when El Yunque was protected, putting the date in the spotlight.
cues: Say that the Spanish crown protected the region
b2-puertorico-consolidation.target: Fue en 1876 cuando la corona española protegió esta región.
b2-puertorico-consolidation.english: It was in 1876 that the Spanish crown protected this region.
b2-puertorico-consolidation.canDo: I can put one idea in the spotlight with a cleft sentence (*Lo que… es…*, *Fue… cuando…*) (review).
